metadata.purpose: Measure FMA accumulation in the N=1442 radix-103 AVX2 pass against the M25 source over all SHT FFT target cells.
metadata.candidate_source_base: RustSHT-FFT M25 source commit e6b0101 plus the M26 source patch identified by SHA-256
metadata.workload: All current exact C2C and real SHT target operation/length cells; one-transform and scalar/spin-1 row batches; one transform thread
metadata.timing: Six alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime AVX2 and FMA dispatch
metadata.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X; process pinned to logical CPU 30
metadata.dispatch_note: The N=1442 radix-103 pass uses AVX2/FMA paired-frequency accumulation when runtime FMA detection succeeds, otherwise the existing AVX2 kernel. The N=1442 inverse safety check and scalar fallback are unchanged. Other lengths use unchanged dispatch.
metadata.runner: ../m24-radix103/run_m24_clean_capture.py records process IDs, uptime, and load averages before, during, and after each run, and fsyncs every JSONL record.

a.label: RustSHT-FFT M26 N=1442 radix-103 AVX2/FMA candidate
